invariants.contract: DELETE narrators/:id removes the narrator from every book of the library keeping the others in order, answers {updated: n}, bumps only those books' updatedAt, leaves the item metadata file alone, emits items_updated to users who can access the library, and drops the name from the cached filter data and the narrators list.

After renames merged three books under one name, removing that name leaves each book's other narrators (an empty list for books with none), answers {updated: 3}, emits items_updated for the three and empties the narrators list of it.
Removing a narrator that no book has any more answers {updated: 0}, changes nothing and emits no event.

DELETE narrators/:id answers 401 without a token, 403 for a user without update permission and for one without library access, 404 for an unknown library, 400 for an invalid page, and changes and emits nothing.
